prior_year_events.impact_description: The syndicate cites major loss events in 2017 which have materially impacted results and prior years' outcomes.
2018 was also a major loss year and is referenced as contributing to prior-year loss experience and reserving pressure.

named_events.loss_description: At the start of the year there were the Australian Floods (part of the series of catastrophic events impacting 2019).
Hurricane Dorian was one of the catastrophic events impacting 2019.
Typhoon Faxai was cited among the 2019 catastrophic events.
Typhoon Hagibis (strongest typhoon to strike mainland Japan in decades) was cited as a major 2019 event.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 gross claims outstanding were GBP 416.7m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse prior-year movement of GBP 5.5m (c.1.3% of opening reserves), driven by deterioration in the 2017 underwriting year. The syndicate attributes reserve and result volatility to a sequence of large catastrophe events (notably the 2017/2018 major loss years) and material 2019 catastrophes (Australian floods, Hurricane Dorian, Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis), together with large losses in Marine and former Property insurance business. Narrative statements reference an overall improvement figure (GBP 6.2m) which appears to be a different (likely net-of-reinsurance) measure; the prior-year movement above is calculated from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: The impact of catastrophe losses on Syndicate 1910 net of reinsurance recoveries added 14.8 percentage points to the combined ratio.
Following the major loss events of 2017 and 2018 we anticipated a material increase in the rating environment for reinsurance.

Our performance for 2019 was impacted by a series of catastrophic events. At the start of the year there were the Australian Floods, these were followed by Hurricane Dorian and then Typhoon's Faxai and Hagibis.
The Syndicate also experienced large losses in the year from the Marine account, as well as from our former Property Insurance business.
In 2019, there has been an overall improvement of GBP 6.2m (2018: improvement GBP 11.6m).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 31). The report also contains a narrative statement of an "overall improvement of GBP 6.2m" which appears to be a different (likely net-of-reinsurance) measure; the PYD above is the gross amount derived from the triangle. The report does not provide gross PYD by line of business, and several reserve-related figures in the narrative appear to be net of reinsurance. Some LOB-level movements could not be quantified from the available disclosures.
